title: astragalus elongatus
intro: Astragalus elongatus, commonly known as the Chinese milkvetch, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including immune system enhancement, anti-inflammatory properties, and anti-aging effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus elongatus are thought to be due to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus elongatus include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
